name: US Census Bureau — American Community Survey

endpoints.description: ACS 5-year detailed tables: select variables with get=, geography with for=/in=

limits.notes: Calls without a key are limited to ~500/day per IP; a free key raises the cap. Max 50 variables per get= request.

llmDocs.summary: US population, income, housing, education and demographic estimates by geography (nation, state, county, tract, block group).
llmDocs.queryGuide: Returns a JSON array-of-arrays; row 0 is the header. Select variables via get= (e.g. NAME,B01001_001E) and geography via for=/in=. e.g. B01001_001E = total population.

exampleQueries.intent: Median household income for one county

gotchas: Variable codes end in E for estimate, M for margin of error
Geography hierarchy matters: 'in=' is required for sub-state geos

compliance.redistributionNotes: US federal data, public domain. ToS requires attribution and prohibits implying Census endorsement.
